text_en: You've hired the best possible vessel and its engineer, Ini Stormcoil, to take you to the ruins of Zin-Azshari.

name: 海兽号
text: 乘员已经就绪！但这艘潜艇……？
text_en: The crew is ready to begin the voyage! But is the submarine...?

name: 操控潜艇
text: 这艘潜艇堪称现代工程学的奇迹！最好不要按错按钮……
text_en: This vessel is truly a marvel of modern engineering! Better not press the wrong button...

name: 海兽号
text: 潜艇的行进顺畅了许多，特别是在把水排到了舱外之后。
text_en: This vessel runs a lot more smoothly when the water is on the outside and not the inside.

name: 海兽号
text: 与海怪的战斗带来了严重的伤害，以及偷渡者！
text_en: Tangling with a kraken has left catastrophic damage, as well as some stowaways!

name: 海兽号
text: 这一次，你需要用到书中的内容了。
text_en: You'll need every trick in the book to get it going THIS time.

name: 燃料箱
text: 未启动 需要调整才能启动！
text_en: Inactive This needs a tweak to get started!

name: 浸水的燃料箱
text: 已浸水，未启动 修理通常从这里开始。
text_en: Waterlogged, Inactive It's usually best to start with this one.

name: 受潮的燃料箱
text: 未启动 需要调整加热才能使用！
text_en: Inactive This needs a fiery tweak to get going!

name: 燃料箱
text: 已启动 燃料流动正常，准备供能！
text_en: Activated The fuel is flowing and ready to go!

name: 失火的燃料箱
text: 已失火，未启动 需要冷却，别搞坏了！
text_en: On Fire, Inactive This should be cooled without damaging it!

name: 积灰的燃料箱
text: 未启动 需要清洗调校才能恢复！
text_en: Inactive This needs a rinse and a tweak to restore it!

name: 锅炉
text: 未启动 需要撬开才能点火！
text_en: Inactive Pry it open to begin stoking the fires!

name: 浸水的锅炉
text: 已浸水，未启动
text_en: Waterlogged, Inactive

name: 受潮的锅炉
text: 未启动 需要用加热过的工具撬开。
text_en: Inactive It still needs to be pried open with something hot.

name: 锅炉
text: 已启动 可以给锅炉供燃料了！
text_en: Activated The boiler is ready to receive some fuel!

name: 失火的锅炉
text: 已失火，未启动 熄灭火焰。不要伤到锅炉。
text_en: On Fire, Inactive Put out the flames without harming the boiler.

name: 积灰的锅炉
text: 未启动 用工具打开锅炉，清空灰尘。
text_en: Inactive Open the boiler with a tool that also clears out the ash.

name: 压力阀
text: 未启动 控制流量以启动。
text_en: Inactive Tap on this to activate it.

name: 浸水的压力阀
text: 已浸水，未启动
text_en: Waterlogged, Inactive

name: 受潮的压力阀
text: 未启动 排干水之前无法安全使用。
text_en: Inactive It's not safe to use this until the water's been pounded out.

name: 压力阀
text: 已启动 可以正常操作了！
text_en: Activated Ready to operate!

name: 失火的压力阀
text: 已失火，未启动 仔细扑灭火焰，使其恢复运转。
text_en: On Fire, Inactive Combat the flames carefully to restore it.

name: 积灰的压力阀
text: 未启动 需要用沾了水的工具敲打才能使用。
text_en: Inactive Whack this with something watery to get it operational.

name: 海兽导弹
text: 当伊妮受到攻击时，随机对敌方随从造成1-3点伤害。
text_en: Ini deals 1-3 damage to random enemy minions when she is attacked.

name: 海兽导弹
text: 当伊妮受到攻击时，随机对敌方随从造成1-3点伤害。
text_en: Deals 1-3 damage to random enemy minions when attacked.

name: 海兽号的探爪
text: 突袭。圣盾。在本随从攻击后，抽一张牌。
text_en: [x]Rush, Divine Shield After this attacks, draw a card.

name: 雷霆绽放
text: 在本回合中，获得两个法力水晶。过载：（2）
text_en: Gain 2 Mana Crystals this turn only. Overload: (2)

name: 闪电风暴
text: 对所有敌方随从造成$3点伤害，过载：（2）
text_en: Deal $3 damage to all_enemy minions. Overload: (2)

name: 老响劫
text: 他对战利品特别敏感，但有时金子也能吸引他的注意。
text_en: He's got a keen eye for loot, but sometimes throwing gold around can work against him.

name: 偷来的幸运币
text: 被动 使你的敌人猜测双方手牌的法力值消耗总和哪一方更大，猜中即可获取一张幸运币。
text_en: Passive Your enemy guesses whose hand has greater total Mana Cost to earn a Coin.

name: 低！
text: 猜测敌人手牌法力值消耗的总和比你的低。
text_en: Guess that the enemy's hand has a lesser total Mana Cost than yours.

name: 高！
text: 猜测敌人手牌法力值消耗的总和比你的高。
text_en: Guess that the enemy's hand has a greater total Mana Cost than yours.

name: 机械鲨鱼
text: 在你召唤一个机械后，造成3点伤害，随机分配到所有敌人身上。
text_en:
[x]After you summon a Mech,
deal 3 damage randomly
_split among all enemies.

name: 金刚刃牙兽
text: 战吼：使你的其他机械获得+2攻击力。
text_en: Battlecry: Give your other Mechs +2 Attack.

text: 发现你牌库中一张牌的复制。如果你在本回合中使用这张复制，则抽取本体。

 If it dies, draw a card.

text_en: Rush Deathrattle: Summon two random Mechs that cost (3) or less.

text: 使卡耶获得亡语：随机使你手牌中的一张随从牌获得+3/+3，抽一张牌。

text: 嘲讽。在你使用一张鱼人牌后，对所有敌人造成2点伤害。
text_en: Taunt After you play a Murloc deal 2 damage to all enemies.

name: 摩戈洛
text: 它的攻击倾向令人担心……即便是从鱼人的标准来看。
text_en: Its level of aggression is concerning... even for a murloc.

text: 被动 在一个友方鱼人死亡后，使你的一个鱼人获得+1生命值。

name: 狂欢！
text: +1生命值。
text_en: +1 Health.

text: 战吼：在本局对战中你每使用过一张鱼人牌，对敌方随从造成1点伤害。

name: 纳迦巨人
text: 嘲讽
text_en: Taunt

name: 纳迦卫兵
text: 即便这里有纳迦驻守，现在也没有退缩的余地了。
text_en: Even if the territorial naga are here, it's impossible to back out now.

name: 上古三叉戟
text: 装备一把上古三叉戟。
text_en: Equip an Ancient Trident.

name: 自然研习
text: 发现一张法术牌。你的下一张法术牌法力值消耗减少（1）点。
text_en: Discover a spell. Your next one costs (1) less.

name: 私掠者汤姆
text: 如果格蕾丝需要和这艘船的船长对质，那我们现在就去！
text_en: If Grace needs to confront the captain of this ship, we'd better get to it!

text: 费林或其盟友必须击败本随从，将它抢救回来。

[x]After Grace attacks, look at
3 cards in your opponent's
hand and choose one.
It can't be played next turn.

text: 在下个回合开始时，将你的英雄变形，并被吸入扭曲虚空！
text_en: At the start of next turn, your hero is transformed and sucked through the Twisting Nether.

name: 刺客视界
text: 奥秘：当你的对手使用一张具有潜行的随从牌时，为所有随从装备一把匕首。
text_en: Secret: When your opponent plays a minion with Stealth, All minions equip a dagger.

name: 隐匿行踪
text: 潜行
text_en: Stealth.

name: 野蛮人视界
text: 奥秘：当你的对手使用一张具有冲锋的随从牌时，获得雷霆之怒。
text_en: Secret: When your opponent plays a minion with Charge, THUNDER FURY!

name: 憎恨视界
text: 奥秘：当双方英雄的生命值小于或等于15点时，使用绝命乱斗。
text_en: Secret: When both heroes have 15 or less Health, BRAWL!

name: 圣教军视界
text: 奥秘：当你的对手使用一个具有嘲讽的随从时，将所有随从的攻击力变为1。
text_en: Secret: When your opponent plays a minion with Taunt, change all minions' attacks to 1.

name: 勇气视界
text: 奥秘：当你的对手使用一张传说随从牌时，使所有随从获得风怒。
text_en: Secret: When your opponent plays a Legendary minion, give all minions Windfury

name: 命运视界
text: 奥秘：当你的对手遭到致命伤害时…拯救他。
text_en: Secret: When your opponent takes lethal damage... save him.

name: 亚马逊视界
text: 奥秘：当你的对手使用一张具有战吼的随从牌时，为双方英雄召唤一个镜像。
text_en: Secret: When your opponent plays a minion with Battlecry, Summon a Mirror Image for both players.

name: 巫师视界
text: 奥秘：当你的对手使用一张具有法术伤害的随从牌时，召唤2个守卫。
text_en: Secret: When your opponent plays a minion with Spell Damage, Summon 2 Guardians.

name: 死灵法师视界
text: 奥秘：当你的对手使用一张具有亡语的随从牌时，消灭该随从。
text_en: Secret: When your opponent plays a card with Deathrattle, destroy it.

name: 知识视界

text_en: Secret: When your opponent's hand has 9 or more cards, reduce the cost of all cards in both hands to (1).

text: 随从拥有嘲讽。

text_en: Draw Offensive Play on first, third, and fifth turn

你的下一个目标来了
text: 消灭所有随从。吸取所有法力值。获得5点生命值。
text_en: Destroy all minions. Drain all Mana. Gain 5 Health.

name: 丛林激斗
text: 丛林中不仅潜伏着凶猛的巨兽，还有更黑暗的东西……
text_en: Enter the jungle with giant beasts and darker things...

name: 群兽奔腾
text: 释放出成群的猛兽，捕猎沼泽女王！
text_en: Release a stampede of beasts while hunting for the Marsh Queen!

text:
守护你的奥秘，释放元素
之怒！
text_en: Guard your secrets and unleash elemental fury!

name: 新的英雄！
text: 新的英雄接替上场。
text_en: A new Hero takes position.

name: 黑暗之光
text: 释放出天启的力量，让圣光屈从于你的意志！
text_en: Bend the Light to your will, while you unleash the Apocalypse!

name: 再接再“励”
text: 激励你的随从，不论死活。
text_en: Inspire your minions, even in death.

name: 信仰之击
text: 以迅雷不及掩耳之势祭出杀招！
text_en: Assassinate with blinding speed!

name: 探秘图腾
text: 揭开对手的所有奥秘，集结你的图腾大军。
text_en: Uncover your adversary's secrets, while assembling your totem army

name: 亡者之咒
text:
召唤可怕的恶魔，烧毁敌人的
武器。
text_en: Summon monstrous demons and burn away the enemy's weapons

name: 磐石压顶
text: 激怒你的随从，并用武器压垮你的对手！
text_en: Enrage your allies, while wielding weapons at your foes!

name: 阿穆纳伊
text: 他可以教你些人生道理，不过是痛不欲生的那种。
text_en: He can teach you life lessons, but they're harsh ones.

name: 巴特鲁德
text: 他的随从不全是木乃伊。也有缠坏了的残次品。
text_en: Not all of Battrund's minions are mummies. Some_got_a_bad_wrap.

name: 布莱恩·铜须
text:
跨上恐龙，但求一战，布莱恩做好了准备，解决这
一切。
text_en:
[x]Riding on a dinosaur
and looking for a fight, 
Brann's ready to finish this.

name: 太阳巨人守护者
text: 所有会投下阴影的东西都是他的 死敌。
text_en: Sworn foe of anything that throws shade.

name: 掠魂之镰
text: 亡语： 召唤所有在本次冒险中被该武器消灭的随从。
text_en: Deathrattle: Summon all minions killed by this weapon this run.

name: 虚灵合约
text: 你的下一张卡牌的法力值消耗为（0）点，并会从你的地下城套牌中移除。
text_en: Your next card costs (0) and is removed from your Dungeon Deck.

text: 你使用的下一张卡牌的法力值消耗为（0）点，并会从你的地下城套牌中移除。
text_en: The next card you play costs (0) and is removed from your dungeon deck.

name: 缔结合约
text: 你施放的下一个法术的法力值消耗为（0）点。
text_en: The next spell you cast this turn cost (0).

name: 虚灵契约
text: 在本回合使用的所有卡牌的法力值消耗为（0）点，并会从你的地下城套牌中移除。
text_en: Cards played this turn cost (0) and are removed from your Dungeon Deck.

name: 缔结契约
text: 在本回合使用的所有卡牌的法力值消耗为（0）点。
text_en: All cards played this turn cost (0).

name: 伊莉斯·逐星
text:
一手魔法，一手弯刀，伊莉斯做好了准备，拯救奥
丹姆。
text_en:
[x]Whether she needs magic
or a trusty machete, Elise 
is ready to save Uldum.

name: 芬利爵士
text: 战驹疾驰，正义将至，芬利爵士做好了准备，惩戒最终的敌人。
text_en:
[x]Sir Finley rides into battle,
ready to dispense justice 
against his final foe.

name: 无头骑士的头
text: 摧毁无头骑士的头可以赢得比赛，但要小心火球！
text_en: Destroy his head to win the game, but watch out for fireballs!

name: 无头骑士（真的没有头）
text: 他听闻了奥丹姆发生的激斗！他也来到了古墓里凑凑 热闹！
text_en: He's seen the battle in Uldum! Now he's here in this tomb!

name: 被诅咒的伊卡博德
text: 他很鲁莽，也很有感染力！
text_en: He's reckless and infectious!

name: 伊希斯特
text: 她一招便能置你于死地，或是用双生法术来炫技。
text_en: She'll either spell your doom, or Twinspell it to show off!

name: 完全正常的罐子
text: 这也太……正常了点吧。
text_en: It's almost… TOO normal.

name: 提问者杰赛罗斯
text: 兽头人身颇可疑，谜题之中复谜题。
text_en: [x]A riddle... within a mystery...in an enigma... with a funny head.

name: 卡兹穆特
text: 能轻易嗅出探险者和恶徒的气息。
text_en: Can sniff out explorers and evildoers with ease.

name: 卡姆
text: 如果你想安抚卡姆就得先让他冷静 下来。
text_en: Calm Kham down if you want to calmly down Kham.

name: 命运之跃
text: 从你的牌库中召唤一个亡语随从的1/1复制。
text_en: Summon a 1/1 copy of a Deathrattle minion from your deck.

name: 重归宿命
text: 召唤一个在本局对战中死亡的友方亡语随从。
text_en: Summon a friendly Deathrattle minion that died this game.

name: 生死之交
text: 冲锋，嘲讽，战吼：和其他朋友合为一体，直到永远。
text_en: Charge, Taunt. Battlecry: Combines with other Friends. Lasts. FOREVER.

name: 巫妖巴兹亚尔
text: 哪个组织凉得更快？她一定要搞 清楚！
text_en: Which league freezes faster? She must find out!

name: 八爪巨怪
text: 八爪巨怪用的是八进制计数法。
text_en: You can count on Octosari to keep the numbers balanced.

name: 匪贼德莱萨
text: 她要是问你有没有财宝，一定要说 没有！
text_en: If she asks you about treasure, you don't have any!

name: 拉夏
text: 在施放法术之时，太阳尊主的强光最为炽烈。
text_en: The Mighty Lord of the Sun shines brightest when_casting_spells.

name: 雷诺·杰克逊
text:
带好宝藏，剪好胡须，雷诺做好了准备，干掉塔
卡恒！
text_en:
[x]With a bag full of treasures 
and a well-styled moustache,
 Reno is ready to take 
Tekahn down!

name: 塞特斯
text: 典型的坏狗狗，专业拆家。
text_en: Just your typical bad dog, destroying everything.

name: 索西斯
text: 泰坦守卫看上去面无表情，非常 严肃。
text_en: Titan security is very serious. Stone-faced, even.

name: 愚人的金子
text: 随机使你的一张手牌法力值消耗减为（0）点。
text_en: Reduce the Cost of a random card in your hand to (0).

name: 愚弄
text: 法力值消耗为（0）点。
text_en: Costs (0).

name: 老托巴
text: 宝藏猎人老托巴并不想干这些抄袭的勾当。
text_en: Ol' Toomba the treasure hunter isn't above copying_homework.

name: 布满陷阱的房间
text: 都知道是陷阱了，还能算陷阱吗？
text_en: Is it still a trap if everyone knows it's a trap?

name: 看我找到了什么
text: 发现一张宝藏牌。
text_en: Discover a Treasure.

name: 黑暗仪祭师扎法尔
text: 他认为他的仪式比任何人都棒。
text_en: Believes his rituals are better than anyone else's.

name: 扎拉姆
text: 扎拉姆的随从就是他力量的代价。
text_en: Zaraam grows in strength the more his minions suffer.

name: 无头骑士
text: 他听闻了奥丹姆发生的激斗！他也来到了古墓里凑凑 热闹！
text_en: He's seen the battle in Uldum! Now he's here in this tomb!

name: 友谊（无法被沉默）
text: 属性值提高
text_en: Increased Stats

name: 阿兰娜·逐星
text: 永不服输的天生领袖！
text_en: A natural leader always comes out on top!

name: 废土探险者伊莉斯
text: 关于她妹妹最近的行为，她有几个问题要好好问一问。
text_en: Has some serious questions about her sister's recent activities.

name: 伊利丹·怒风
text: 外域之王想要再比一场！
text_en: The Lord of Outland is looking forward to a rematch!

name: 卡纳克
text: 牧师转职而来的恶魔猎手，基本上可以解决任何问题。
text_en: As a priest turned demon hunter, he's basically capable of anything.

name: 克里兹奇
text: 在外域寻求和平与宁静，却只找到了恶魔猎手。茫茫多的恶魔猎手。
text_en: Sought peace and quiet in Outland, but instead found demon hunters. LOTS of demon hunters.

name: 机械加拉克苏斯
text: 在铁锈与愤怒中，他得到了重塑！
text_en: With rage and rust, he has been rebuilt!

name: 沙尔亚
text: 即便身处于沙漠之中，她也要把敌人打成落水狗。
text_en: Even in the middle of a desert, she'll ensure her foes are all washed up.

name: 斯克里布
text: 在赞加沼泽，不是你采蘑菇，是蘑菇踩你！他就是证明。
text_en: He's proof that in Zangarmarsh, the mushrooms hunt YOU!

name: 夺命钉板
name_en: Board with a Nail in It
text: 战吼：对你的英雄造成5点伤害。
